import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/profession/replaceEquip/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 替换职业工具指令
 * 用于切换火焰、丹炉、炼器台等天工工具
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid, messageText: e.MessageText, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  if (result.code === 'LIST') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const groups = new Map<string, Array<(typeof result.data.tools)[number]>>();

    for (const tool of result.data.tools) {
      const list = groups.get(tool.typeName) ?? [];

      list.push(tool);
      groups.set(tool.typeName, list);
    }

    if (result.data.tools.length === 0) {
      md.addText('当前没有可切换的天工工具');
    } else {
      md.addText('可切换天工');
      md.addNewline();

      for (const [typeName, tools] of groups) {
        md.addText(`【${typeName}】`);
        md.addNewline();
        for (const tool of tools) {
          md.addText(`【${tool.id}】${tool.name}-${tool.grade}`);

          addOptions(md, [
            { label: '切换', command: `/切换 ${tool.id}` },
            { label: '详情', command: `/物品详情 ${tool.name}` }
          ]);

          md.addNewline();
        }
      }
    }

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '切换天工', content: md, footer: [{ label: '我的职业', command: '/我的职业' }] }));

    return;
  }

  try {
    if (result.code === 'OK') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`✅ ${result.data.message}`);
      md.addNewline();

      if (result.data.equipment) {
        md.addText(`装备名称：${result.data.equipment.name}`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`品级：${result.data.equipment.gradeName}`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`类型：${result.data.equipment.typeName}`);
        md.addNewline();
      }

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '切换天工', content: md, footer: [{ label: '我的职业', command: '/我的职业' }] }));
    } else if (result.code === 'FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, result.uid, '切换天工', `❤ ${result.message}`, createBackendRequestContext(e));

      md.addText(failMsg);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
    } else {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('替换职业工具失败，请稍后重试');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('替换职业工具失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('替换职业工具失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
